title_cn: 特朗普和内塔尼亚胡会晤的主要收获
summary: US President Donald Trump welcomed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to the White House for talks on Tuesday. The Israeli prime minister pressed the US to ensure Iran never acquires nuclear weapons. Netanyahu was in Washington for the funeral of Senator Lindsey Graham, a longtime Iran hawk. Bloomberg's Dan Williams breaks down the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Malaysia Arrests 335 in Online Scam Raids at Johor’s Forest City
title_cn: 马来西亚在柔佛森林城市网络诈骗袭击中逮捕 335 人
summary: Malaysian police arrested 335 people in raids on two alleged international online scam syndicates operating out of the Forest City development in the southern state of Johor, adding to scrutiny of the project.

title: India Cockroach Party Warns of New Protest After Court Order
title_cn: 印度蟑螂党警告法庭命令后将举行新的抗议活动
summary: India’s Cockroach Janta Party threatened to resume nationwide protests if the government goes back on its assurance to drop police complaints against student demonstrators who forced the nation’s education minister to resign over examination paper leaks.
